nota.es: C.T.P.s propios (como /api/ctps de thanosvibs). El de Ascenso (도약의 C.T.P.), nuevo el 14 de octubre de 2026: la nota da los valores de cada nivel y las dos opciones de reforja (sale una de las dos, con una probabilidad). La descripción es la de la nota, no una opinión como las de thanosvibs. es: el nombre en el juego en español (base, poderoso y brillante, como fuentes/juego-es/ctps.json); null hasta tener la captura del juego: la app muestra el nombre en inglés.

ctps.name: Ascent
ctps.description: New in the October 2026 update: maximizes Instinct Attack (for all allies, when attacking) and, reforged, ignores damage decrease or raises Instinct damage to bosses.
ctps.description_reforged: One of two reforge options, by a set chance: Instinct damage dealt to boss types, or (excluding bosses) ignoring enemy's all damage decrease. Neither applies in duplicate across the team.
stats_normal:
Activation Rate: [P2]% chance when attacking
Applies to: All Allies
Increases Instinct Attack by +[P3]% (5 sec.)
(The effect that applies to all team members cannot be applied in duplicate.)
Cooldown Time 7 seconds

stats_reforge.special:
Applies to: All Allies
Increases Instinct damage dealt to boss types by [P1]%
(The effect that applies to all team members cannot be applied in duplicate.)
stats_reforge.generic:
Applies to: All Allies
Excluding bosses, ignores enemy's all damage decrease by [P1]%.
(The effect that applies to all team members cannot be applied in duplicate.)
